context: Le rattrapage historique s'est arrêté au Canada sur CAPTCHA après 47 championnats acquis. Aucune nouvelle campagne ne doit contourner cet arrêt.
resolution: Operator-authorized weekly restart on 2026-11-02. Historical recovery completed (67/67 leagues) and published on 2026-10-31. Subsequent isolated full-league test completed successfully with all 2292 records restored from remote checkpoints. No active, suspended or access-held durable queues found at review. This reconciles only the historical latch; current source-refusal, ownership, integrity and publication safeguards remain enabled.
